It's also the publisher's answer to the used book market. I can tell you from personal experience (I was an assistant manager at a college bookstore for a couple of years) that the publishers don't like the used book market. The profit margin on new books your local store gets a cut from is something like 10%, as opposed to the 50 - 100% your average B&N will see on the latest best seller, so the markup isn't there. Used books your local store will make somewhere in the neighborhood of a 50% profit on it, but publishers don't see a dime of that.
